description: Unique Identifier - Patient Surrogate Key to maintain the granularity in the dimension table at the source flag and source market level. Strip the literal prefix of data source 'SHA_PTDONC' (REPLACE(patient_sk,'SHA_PTDONC','')) to derive PATIENT_GID
usage_notes: To identify unique patients

description: Mastered (standardised) product name on the claim, aliased to FINAL_PRODUCT_NAME downstream.
usage_notes: To identify product in claim (Column contains Brand Names)

description: Service/fill date of the claim and the primary time dimension of the view.
usage_notes: To identify Service/fill date of the claim

description: MDM-resolved National Provider Identifier of the prescriber on the claim, aliased to NPI_NUMBER. The 'mdm_' prefix indicates the value has already passed through master data management rather than being the raw claim NPI.
usage_notes: HCP Identifier-it is the sole link (along with Abbott Customer ID) from claim to prescriber and account attributes

description: Claim identifier, used as the finest-grain uniqueness token on the claim
usage_notes: Claim identifier, used as the finest-grain uniqueness token on the claim

description: Procedure or HCPCS/J-code associated with the claim.
usage_notes: Use: To identify procedures and distinguish products when the mastered product name alone is not sufficient. Limitation: Not applicable to all claim types and may not independently provide sufficient information to identify the product.

description: Number of days of supply associated with the claim.
usage_notes: Use: To determine claim coverage duration and support treatment episode, regimen, persistence and line-of-therapy analysis. Limitation: Values may be missing or unreliable for certain products/claim types and may require product-specific rules or imputation.

description: Quantity of product dispensed on the claim.
usage_notes: Use: To understand quantity dispensed and support dose and treatment-intensity calculations, primarily for AML analyses. Limitation: Not used in CLL analyses and may contain missing or zero values requiring additional treatment rules.

description: Patient year of birth provided at the source level; only birth year is available due to HIPAA de-identification.
usage_notes: Use: To calculate patient age and create age-based treatment eligibility or patient cohort segments, primarily for AML analyses. Limitation: Only year of birth is available, so exact age cannot be determined; not used for CLL analyses.

description: Identifies the source system/feed from which the claim is derived,(SHA_PTD, PURPLE_LABS or KOMODO).
usage_notes: Use: To select the required claims source and define the appropriate patient population for analysis. Limitation: SHA and KOMODO feeds are not fully interchangeable and may differ in structure and available fields; downstream logic may need to change when switching sources.

description: Identifies the therapeutic market associated with the claim.
usage_notes: Use: To restrict analysis to the required therapeutic area, such as Oncology. Limitation: Should be used with other market/product filters to define the intended patient universe; ONC alone does not define a specific brand or indication.

description: Identifies the specific brand/indication market basket associated with the claim, such as VENC_CLL or VENC_AML.
usage_notes: Use: To define the relevant brand/indication patient universe for analysis. Limitation: Represents a broader market basket and should not be treated as a single-product flag; additional product/indication filters may be required.

description: Identifies the type of claim/fact, such as pharmacy (RX), procedure (PX), surgical (SX), or diagnosis (DX).
usage_notes: Use: To distinguish pharmacy vs. medical activity and identify the appropriate claim type for treatment, activity and eligibility analyses.

description: Episode start date field used to identify the beginning of a treatment episode.
usage_notes: Use: To define treatment episode start dates and calculate episode duration and persistence.

description: Episode end date field used to identify the end of a treatment episode.
usage_notes: Use: To define treatment episode end dates and calculate episode duration, persistence and treatment gaps. Limitation: Field meaning is dependent on the upstream episode derivation/business rules and may require date conversion.

description: Regimen start date associated with the claim/regimen record.
usage_notes: Use: To identify when a regimen or line of therapy starts and support LOT and regimen sequencing analyses. Limitation: Should be interpreted in conjunction with LOT/regimen fields and may depend on upstream regimen assignment rules.

description: Regimen end date associated with the claim/regimen record.
usage_notes: Use: To identify when a regimen or line of therapy ends and calculate duration and gaps between lines. Limitation: End dates are dependent on the underlying regimen construction and may not represent actual clinical discontinuation.

description: Regimen-related field used to capture the derived regimen associated with the record.
usage_notes: Use: To identify and group treatment regimens for regimen-level and line-of-therapy analyses. Limitation: The field is derived/assigned upstream and should be used with the corresponding regimen business rules; field definition may vary by pipeline.

description: When multiple drugs/therapies taken together (based on the days of supply) the combination is shown as regimen
usage_notes: Use: To identify the combination of products used together and classify treatment regimens within a line of therapy. Limitation: Claims-based regimen identification may not capture the complete clinical intent or actual administration sequence.

description: Primary backbone product associated with the treatment regimen.
usage_notes: Use: To identify the primary treatment backbone and group regimens into categories such as CIT, BTKi and BCL2 for LOT and patient-flow analyses. Limitation: Backbone classification is dependent on the upstream regimen/business rules and may simplify combination regimens.

description: Line of Therapy of a patient changes whenever there is a shift to a new product/regimen (based on new to brand from mastered_sob).The line resets when a new therapy starts
usage_notes: Use: To identify 1L, 2L, 3L and subsequent lines of therapy and support patient-flow and treatment-pattern analyses. Limitation: LOT is claims-derived and should not be interpreted as a direct representation of physician-documented clinical lines; assignment depends on the underlying LOT rules.

description: Standardized indication associated with the claim, such as CLL or AML.
usage_notes: Use: To identify the disease indication and define indication-specific patient populations and analyses. Limitation: Depends on the upstream indication mastering logic and should be combined with appropriate market/product filters.
